2026-08-05 deploy round: confirmed the actual working deploy mechanism for these Netlify CLI/API sites (no linked repo) — call the deploy-site MCP operation for a siteId, it returns a `npx -y @netlify/mcp@latest --site-id <id> --proxy-path <token>` command; run that from a staging directory containing ONLY the single index.html to deploy (running it from the repo root would upload the whole repo instead). Verified via byte-diff against the live URL after every deploy. Used this to push feminine/children/fractal/fracture (all byte-confirmed live) and to redeploy faith. fixes/loop.html and fixes/scale.html are ready with the same mechanism whenever the user wants that leak fix pushed — not yet run.
